exposure.needed: whether an operator runs the flux CLI update flow at a time when a release candidate is the latest available version

consequence.statement: The flux CLI update flow keeps working but now skips release candidate versions, so updates no longer pick them up.

assertion.statement: The Flux 2.7.0 CLI now skips release candidate versions when updating (fluxcd/flux2 PR #5507).
